targets.rawQueryText: SELECT AVG(au_pro) AS "AU-PRO", AVG(au_roc) AS "I-AUROC" FROM metrics
targets.queryText: SELECT AVG(au_pro) AS "AU-PRO", AVG(au_roc) AS "I-AUROC" FROM metrics

options.content:
Computed by MVTec's official evaluation script on the MVTec 3D-AD test set.

- **I-AUROC** (image level): how well each part's anomaly score (its map's highest pixel) ranks defective parts above good ones. 1 = perfect, 0.5 = chance.
- **AU-PRO** (pixel level, up to a 30% false positive rate, normalised to 1): how much of each defect the anomaly map covers before too many good pixels are flagged.

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT category AS "Category", au_pro AS "AU-PRO", au_roc AS "I-AUROC" FROM (SELECT category, au_pro, au_roc, 0 AS ord FROM metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'mean', AVG(au_pro), AVG(au_roc), 1 FROM metrics) ORDER BY ord, category
targets.queryText: SELECT category AS "Category", au_pro AS "AU-PRO", au_roc AS "I-AUROC" FROM (SELECT category, au_pro, au_roc, 0 AS ord FROM metrics UNION ALL SELECT 'mean', AVG(au_pro), AVG(au_roc), 1 FROM metrics) ORDER BY ord, category
